1.w: You godly ones, shout for joy because of the Lord ! It is appropriate for the morally upright to offer him praise.

2.w: Give thanks to the Lord with the harp. Sing to him to the accompaniment of a ten-stringed instrument.

3.w: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully as you shout out your praises to him.

4.w: For the Lord ’s decrees are just, and everything he does is fair.

5.w: He promotes equity and justice; the Lord ’s faithfulness extends throughout the earth.

6.w: By the Lord ’s decree the heavens were made, and by the breath of his mouth all the starry hosts.

7.w: He piles up the water of the sea; he puts the oceans in storehouses.

8.w: Let the whole earth fear the Lord . Let all who live in the world stand in awe of him.

9.w: For he spoke, and it came into existence. He issued the decree, and it stood firm.

10.w: The Lord frustrates the decisions of the nations; he nullifies the plans of the peoples.

11.w: The Lord ’s decisions stand forever; his plans abide throughout the ages.

12.w: How blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord , the people whom he has chosen to be his special possession.

13.w: The Lord watches from heaven; he sees all people.

14.w: From the place where he lives he looks carefully at all the earth’s inhabitants.

15.w: He is the one who forms every human heart, and takes note of all their actions.

16.w: No king is delivered by his vast army; a warrior is not saved by his great might.

17.w: A horse disappoints those who trust in it for victory; despite its great strength, it cannot deliver.

18.w: Look, the Lord takes notice of his loyal followers, those who wait for him to demonstrate his faithfulness

19.w: by saving their lives from death and sustaining them during times of famine.

20.w: We wait for the Lord ; he is our deliverer and shield.

21.w: For our hearts rejoice in him, for we trust in his holy name.

22.w: May we experience your faithfulness, O Lord , for we wait for you.
